resources.string: Restore the ADB setting at startup and whenever it is turned off. Works without Wi-Fi when the settings permission is already granted. DiLink 5 can also use wireless recovery on validated Wi-Fi with a previously authorized key.
Use compatible BYD tools to request ADB access. A Wi-Fi connection isn\'t required.
Diagnose problems, open BYD tools or undo a manual attempt.
Approve wireless debugging on this network
Connect to a validated Wi-Fi network first. Allow OverDrive to confirm the wireless debugging dialog only for this network.
Manual enablement isn\'t available for the current mode or installed BYD tools.
Local recovery needs the settings permission granted during ADB setup. It does not need Wi-Fi or DiLink 5 mode.

OverDrive will restore the ADB setting using its previously granted settings permission, without needing Wi-Fi. On DiLink 5, wireless recovery can also use validated Wi-Fi and your previously authorized key. ADB on port 5555 may be reachable from other devices on the vehicle network. Use a network you trust. ADB key authentication remains enabled.
Settings permission is missing. If ADB is also unavailable, use Enable ADB or Developer options first, then complete ADB setup again.
The ADB setting is enabled. An authenticated ADB connection has not been confirmed.
The ADB setting could not be enabled and verified. This firmware may reject the change.
The automatic recovery preference could not be saved. Check ADB and try again.
